newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African average T-Bill rate 15.01 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.African average T-Bill rate 15.01 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for South African three-month Treasury Bills fell to 15.01 percent at the latest weekly tender after holding steady at 15.04 percent last week, the Reserve Bank said.
Applications for the 700 million rand of bills on offer totalled 2.072 billion rand. The average price was 96.260 rand percent.

The average rate for six-month bills was 14.78 percent from 14.73 percent. Applications for the 200 million rand of bills on offer totalled 815 million rand. The average price was 92.630 rand percent.
